$comment: SNO→hub AMQP federation (#51). Hub-01 AMQPS Route when spokeProvisioning.enabled (serving cert -ptls; do not flip global tls.enabled). Isolated edge-broker-policies ActiveMQArtemis uses mustonlyhave, spec.brokerProperties address federation, exposed AMQPS. Modules 1–6 retarget to SNO Routes. ApplicationSet / ztp-policies stay unbound. Hub spoke-* CRs stay.

criteria.target: helm template test . --set global.clusterDomain=ci-test.example.com --set spokeProvisioning.enabled=true 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'name: amqps-acceptor' && helm template test . --set global.clusterDomain=ci-test.example.com --set spokeProvisioning.enabled=true 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'sslSecret: amqps-acceptor-ptls'

helm template test . --set global.clusterDomain=ci-test.example.com --set spokeProvisioning.enabled=true 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'trustAll=true' && helm template test . --set global.clusterDomain=ci-test.example.com --set spokeProvisioning.enabled=true 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'useTopologyForLoadBalancing=false'
grep -q 'mustonlyhave' templates/edge-broker-policies.yaml && grep -q 'sslEnabled: true' templates/edge-broker-policies.yaml && grep -q 'amqps-acceptor-ptls' templates/edge-broker-policies.yaml
grep -q 'Do not bind ztp-policies' templates/spoke-rhacm-policies.yaml && ! helm template test . --set global.clusterDomain=ci-test.example.com 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'amqps-acceptor-ptls'
